$comment: Inscriptions of the demo village, key = repo name. inscription: 1 to 140 characters; cause: cause of death, at most 80 (ignored for living repos); mourner: who (Hollis, Marigold or Barnaby) and text (at most 100). No dashes or emojis. A repo without an entry gets a plain inscription from facts. Build with: node tools/demo-world.mjs

bellrope.inscription: Rang a bell on new mail for thirteen commits in spring 2025, then went quiet. Fixed its memory leak, which is more than most of us manage.
bellrope.cause: Memory leak in the worker, then no commits after May 2025

mourner.text: Properly buried, which I rarely get to say. Shortcuts and pagination were each committed twice.

brambleboard.inscription: The board grew like a hedge until nobody trimmed it. 41 days without a push; at 49 it joins the graveyard.
brambleboard.cause: Commits thinned to one a month, then a 120 day pause and a late flurry

mourner.text: Six commits in September, then the window went dark. Otis and Juno kept it lit most of a year.

candle-timer.inscription: Here rests candle-timer, a Pomodoro timer begun in August 2024. It received two commits in one active week and was then left alone.
candle-timer.cause: Work stopped after two commits in a single week; no later activity recorded

mourner.text: Two commits, both named Initial commit. Little work, but it was dug properly and has stayed dug.

crow-cache.inscription: 64 commits and counting. The chimney is smoking, so someone is home.

mourner.text: Went quiet for 160 days, then came back with 8 commits in October. Stubborn little house.

design-tokens.inscription: 66 days without a push. 37 commits from one author, and a README still promising colour for every app. Still breathing.
design-tokens.cause: Single maintainer; last commits were small fixes and a retry, then silence

mourner.text: Last light out was 26 August. Longest dark before this was 18 days. I have been counting.

dotfiles.inscription: Two hands kept these shell settings going through 43 commits. The silence has now matched its longest pause on record.
dotfiles.cause: Two hands tinkering in turn, and nobody left to decide when it counts as done

mourner.text: Its last light went out on 9 September, and it has been the longest dark I have walked past.

fernhollow-orders.inscription: Morning bake pre-orders, kept by Wren and Pim over 76 commits and 23 active weeks. The 4 am print still runs.

mourner.text: Twelve days since the last push, and its longest pause was nine. Still a healthy house, I'd say.

fernhollow-shop.inscription: Bread, pastries and 142 commits. Three hands built this shop for Fernhollow, and it still keeps its doors open.

mourner.text: Otis, Pim and Juno watered this house through 31 active weeks. Nine quiet days at most.

fernhollow-website.inscription: Built for Fernhollow Bakery over 39 commits and 10 active weeks. It ended with a handover guide and stands as delivered.

mourner.text: Last light out on 15 December. Quiet since, though it burned steadily for ten weeks.

ferrywell.inscription: Still sending, one chunk at a time, over the hotel wifi. Wren and Otis keep the chimney smoking.

mourner.text: Wren and Otis tend it well. The resume fix has taken root, and I've not seen a wilt since.

ferrywell-gui.inscription: Two keepers, 118 commits, and no pause longer than nine days. Smoke still rises from the chimney.

mourner.text: Five days since the last push, and the longest dry spell was nine. Thriving, if you ask me.

ferrywell-landing.inscription: Twenty-three commits over sixteen active weeks, and a pricing table to show for it. Quiet for eleven days, but the chimney still smokes.

mourner.text: Six commits in October. Eleven quiet days is nothing, though it once sat dry for 26 days.

ferrywell-legacy.inscription: The first ferrywell, written in Python over 58 commits by Wren. Its work lives on in ferrywell, and this crypt is kept for it.

mourner.text: Its light went out 700 days ago. Wren made 50 of its 58 commits, and the lane was quieter after.

fog-machine.inscription: Twelve commits in four active weeks, the last pushed in January. It worked on the author's machine, which is where it stayed.
fog-machine.cause: Experiment dropped in January after four active weeks, with no successor named.

mourner.text: Dug this one in a hurry, I'd say. Nine commits in December, then "try again" and a long quiet.

gloam.inscription: Three hands and 312 commits later, the page still dims as the evening goes on. Someone keeps the lamp lit.

mourner.text: The worker's memory leak is fixed, so the house sleeps through the night now.

gloam-api.inscription: Sync and accounts for gloam. 188 commits so far, and the chimney is still smoking, so someone is still up with it.

mourner.text: Fixed that flaky test twice. Returning 429 over 503 was the right call. Watch the wip commits.

gloam-docs.inscription: Help centre and API docs for gloam, kept by two hands over 64 commits. The lamp is low, but the smoke still rises.

mourner.text: Juno waters most of this bed, 49 of 64 commits. It went dry for 18 days once, then came back up.

gloam-landing.inscription: Forty-six commits, two keepers, and the chimney still smokes. The porch light stays on for visitors.

mourner.text: A 39 day dry spell once, but it came back green. Someone fixed the crash on empty input twice.

gloam-v1.inscription: First version of gloam, kept by Wren and Juno across 74 commits. The lamp now burns in gloam, its successor.

mourner.text: Not dug in a hurry. Its last commit pointed the README at gloam, the proper way to leave.

gravel-sh.inscription: Buried by hand, though it never really died. Fifteen commits, one of them 'try again', and no push in 130 days.
gravel-sh.cause: Momentum ran out in June, mid-refactor by the look of 'wip' and 'try again'.

mourner.text: Dug this one in a hurry. Fifteen commits, and one of them still says try again.

hearthbook.inscription: Recipes for families who share one kitchen. Three cooks, 156 commits, and the chimney is still smoking.

mourner.text: Three gardeners in this bed, Otis the busiest. Watered three days back, still standing tall.

hearthbook-ios.inscription: 92 commits from two pairs of hands, and the chimney still smokes. The screen stays awake while the pot is on.

mourner.text: Thirty active weeks of watering. Otis and Juno take turns. Even the wip commits got a drink.

hearthbook-landing.inscription: Juno keeps the hearthbook landing page warm across 31 commits, through one 34 day lull, with smoke still rising from the chimney.

mourner.text: Juno waters it in bursts. Seven commits in August, then a long dry spell. Still green, though.

hearthbook-proto.inscription: Ancestor of hearthbook. Its clickable prototype took 22 commits to build, and the work lives on there.
hearthbook-proto.cause: Superseded by hearthbook after the Kotlin rewrite.

mourner.text: Its light went out on purpose, after one last build ahead of the Kotlin rewrite. I still checked.

hollow-icons.inscription: Here rest the outlines of an icon set: 27 commits between March and July 2025, and a README that never grew past one line.
hollow-icons.cause: Went quiet after July 2025; the README never got past one line.

mourner.text: Its light went out in July 2025. I still notice the gap in the lane at night.

infra.inscription: Servers, DNS and databases kept as code by one keeper. 204 commits in, and the chimney is still smoking.

mourner.text: Wren raised the database disk to 40 GB. The bed is well fed, and it has not been dry for long.

inkpot-cli.inscription: Nineteen commits, one keeper, and a chimney that still smokes. The lamp has been low for eight days.

mourner.text: Ten commits in October and the runtime pinned twice so it stays put. Standing up straight.

kettle-classic.inscription: The Rails years of the shopping list, 61 commits strong. Its work lives on in kettle-sync, its successor.

mourner.text: Last light out in April 2025, after the gems were frozen. The lamp burns on in kettle-sync.

kettle-sync.inscription: Keeps shared shopping lists in step. Quiet for 48 days, but the light is still on for whoever comes back.

mourner.text: 48 days without a push, yet the site still answers. Wren and Bex left good soil here.

lamplighter.inscription: Smoke still rises from the chimney. Seventy-three commits, two keepers, and a sync queue that no longer races.

mourner.text: Seventeen dry days once. Wren and Otis watered it back, and it has stayed green since.

lanternfish.inscription: The light is still on. 97 commits by Otis and Juno, and the sky is still being watched.

mourner.text: Passed the house again last night. Light still on. 64 days quiet, and I still look up.

lanternfish-landing.inscription: The light is still on. Eighteen commits over eleven active weeks, one author, and the site still answers.

mourner.text: The site still answers and the light is on. Nothing is wilting, only resting. I'll keep watering.

magpie-scraper.inscription: Collects shiny links. 38 commits over 23 active weeks, and the smoke is still rising from the chimney.

mourner.text: Nineteen quiet days once, and it still came back up. Runtime pinned, so it sleeps well.

midnight-chess.inscription: Here lies a chess engine that only played after dark. Thirty-four commits over eleven active weeks, and it resigned politely.
midnight-chess.cause: Ran out of evenings. Last words: a polite resignation and small fixes.

mourner.text: Dug this one in a hurry. Thirty-four commits, and the recent ones say 'more wip'.

moorwatch.inscription: Here rests moorwatch, who warned hikers about the weather across 96 commits. Pricing remained a TODO.
moorwatch.cause: Stalled after a TODO about API pricing; nobody pushed again

mourner.text: Ended on a TODO about pricing, right after removing dead code. I dug this one in a hurry.

moorwatch-landing.inscription: Fourteen commits over seven active weeks, all by Juno. The README runs to one sentence and says what it is.
moorwatch-landing.cause: Commits thinned every month, then the pushes stopped in March.

mourner.text: The last light on this lane went out on 15 March. Fourteen commits, then a long dark.

moss-render.inscription: 77 commits, 72 of them from Wren, and the shadow pass was left half finished. The chart is not encouraging.
moss-render.cause: Shadow pass stopped halfway; no pushes in 74 days

mourner.text: Lit on and off from January to August. The last light went out halfway through the shadow pass.

night-shift.inscription: Twenty-one commits over six active weeks, and the chimney still smokes. Sleeping, not gone.

mourner.text: Two wip commits, a flaky test fixed twice, a race fixed in the queue. The lamp still burns.

nightjar-wiki.inscription: The old team wiki. Its final commit made it read only, and nobody came back to it.
nightjar-wiki.cause: Last commit made it read only; no one pushed again after May 2024.

mourner.text: Last light went out in May 2024. Read only mode was its final commit, and I saw nothing after.

owl-pager.inscription: Three commits in one active week, a one-line README, and then the night stayed quiet. Rest well.
owl-pager.cause: Three days of experiments, then no return. The README never grew past one line.

mourner.text: Its light went out on the 26th of September. I noticed from the lane. I always notice.

puddle-db.inscription: Here lies a key value store that called itself very shallow in its README, and meant it. Nine commits, one author, March 2025.
puddle-db.cause: Abandoned in March 2025 after four active weeks, with no finish line

mourner.text: Light went out in March 2025. Nine commits, then dark. I still glance at that window on my rounds.

quillmere-edi.inscription: Built for Quillmere Freight: 57 commits across 18 active weeks. Delivered, and kept standing as a monument.

mourner.text: Its light went out in September, and it has been dark since. Still, it was kept in good order.

quillmere-portal.inscription: Built for Quillmere Freight by three hands over 203 commits. Final release 1.8.0 shipped, and it has stood since.

mourner.text: Its lamp went out after the final release, 1.8.0. Never once sat idle longer than eight days.

quillmere-tracking.inscription: 118 commits of pallet tracking and one sync race fixed. The bays are still being counted.

mourner.text: Forty weeks of watering, and one dry spell of 130 days. It came back green, which is all I ask.

rune-parser.inscription: Here lies the lexer, rewritten in parts, after 180 commits of honest effort. Rest well.
rune-parser.cause: Lexer rewrite, part 4, never reached its end

mourner.text: Dug this one myself. The lexer was half torn out, and no one came back to finish it.

saltgrove-app.inscription: Where frames are tried on through the camera. Built by Otis and Juno over 64 commits for Saltgrove Opticians.

mourner.text: Otis and Juno kept this one watered well. Twenty quiet days is a dry spell, not yet a wilt.

saltgrove-booking.inscription: Built for Saltgrove Opticians: 88 commits over 30 active weeks, and never a pause longer than 10 days.

mourner.text: Two hands kept this one lit, Otis and Pim Larkspur. The light went out in March and I noticed.

shipwright.inscription: Helpers for releasing and rolling back, tended by Wren and Otis across sixty-seven commits. The chimney is smoking.

mourner.text: Pagination was fixed twice and rollbacks now retry the health check first. Someone is minding it.

sparrow-chat.inscription: Group chat for small teams. Three authors, 210 commits and 69 active weeks, and the README never needed more than one line.
sparrow-chat.cause: Public server shut down; commit pace thinned out through late 2024

mourner.text: Commits dwindled from 19 in August 2024 to 4 in December. Then the public server went dark.

status-page.inscription: Still lit. Otis left 29 commits here, and the page still answers when you knock on it.

mourner.text: 95 days since the last push, and the light in that window is still on. I notice when they go out.

sundial-api.inscription: Quiet for 58 days, with 32 left before the grave. Its last commit moved the time zone data into a gem.
sundial-api.cause: Its core data moved into a gem, leaving the service little to do

mourner.text: Its last light went out 3 September. Two commits that month, then the lane stayed dark.

tallowmoor-handbook.inscription: How we work, written down so nobody has to ask twice. Three hands have kept the lamp lit.

mourner.text: Juno did most of the watering. 42 days went dry once, and I still think about it.

tallowmoor-website.inscription: Our own house, raised by Juno and Otis over 54 commits. The chimney still smokes and the lamp is still on.

mourner.text: Most months it gets a few commits. It went 29 days dry once and still came back up nicely.

teacup-orm.inscription: Forty-one commits and twenty-two active weeks, and the kettle is still on. Keep an eye on the worker's memory.

mourner.text: The worker's memory leak was fixed twice, so I keep an eye on that root. Otis still waters it.

thimble-vm.inscription: Here lies the smallest virtual machine we could think of. Four commits in one week; the opcode table stayed half done.
thimble-vm.cause: Abandoned mid-build after one week; the opcode table was never finished.

mourner.text: Dug this one in a hurry. Four commits, one week, and the opcode table still half finished.

tindervale-members.inscription: Delivered to the Tindervale Rowing Club with 71 commits from two hands. The final push exported the list for the annual meeting.

mourner.text: Its light went out in June 2025 after the export. Still standing, so I pass it every night.

tindervale-regatta.inscription: Regatta results for Tindervale Rowing Club, built by Otis and Juno over twelve active weeks. Still rowing between heats.

mourner.text: 26 days since the last push, and still no wilting. Otis and Juno kept the beds tidy.

tindervale-site.inscription: For Tindervale Rowing Club, built by Juno in six active weeks. Delivered, and standing as handed over.

mourner.text: Its last light went out in June. Between commits it never sat dark longer than three days.

wickstat.inscription: A light is still on in this house. Fifty-two commits, a worker's memory leak patched twice, and the site still answers.

mourner.text: Wren watered this one all winter. Quiet 38 days, but the site still answers. Not wilting yet.

willow-ml.inscription: Forty-six commits over thirteen weeks spent guessing when the willow lets go. Buried by hand, though the willow kept its leaves.
willow-ml.cause: Experiment set aside after its October push; no client, no successor

mourner.text: Seventeen commits in September, then three in October. I dug this one by hand, and quickly.
